AboutUs.title: A Saudi engineering team, accountable for the number on the bill.
AboutUs.desc1: Dosan Energy is based in Riyadh and works across the Kingdom. We bring best-in-class cooling technology — Oxycom indirect evaporative cooling, Hisense VRF, Ener.co coatings — and take the whole scope: engineering and design, installation, commissioning, analytics and maintenance.
AboutUs.desc2: One team is answerable for the result, which is why our case studies quote energy and cost outcomes rather than equipment lists.

KitchenSolution.title: Cooler kitchens, lower bills.
KitchenSolution.desc: Every cubic metre your hood extracts must come back in. IntrCooll delivers it cooled, filtered and 100% fresh — at a fraction of the capex and opex of a DX fresh-air unit, with zero refrigerant above the kitchen.
